comment: C7-C10 of RUNTIME-ACCEPTANCE-CONDITIONS.md (founder 2026-09-28): the direction for when the code decides and when an agent is called, as data the runtime reads. tier: code = a rule decides, no model in the loop; model = the session model answers in its own turn; agent = the code calls a model and waits. field: the one field of that step the tier decides. ladder: that field's stringency order, low to high; an agent answer is applied only when it moves UP the ladder. agent_when: the condition under which a code step escalates; null = never. never_agent: what an agent may never decide for this step. threshold: the confidence below which the code asks; null = never ask, the code always stands.

agent.how: the ask is detached the moment the code lands below its threshold; the answer lands in <turn>.<step>.ask.json and is read by the next step that needs the field. No agent call ever sits on the turn's hot path.
agent.caller: runtime/lib/tier.sh --ask, which goes through the review lane's own caller so the key resolution and the fail-closed egress scrub live in one place

thresholds_note: Only placement carries a number today, and it was measured rather than guessed: across session 94a0f78e every placement the engine produced scored 0.28-0.44 and every one of them was in fact answered by hand before a write could proceed, which is precisely the case the threshold names. Reversal trigger: if the agent's placement answer is refused by the raise-only rule, or disagrees with the address finally recorded, in more than 1 of 10 asks, the number comes back out and placement returns to null. Every other step stays null until 200 turns of confidence have been logged (section 4 of the conditions).

rules.raise_only: an agent answer may raise stringency (deeper, stricter, more review) and never lower it; a lowering answer is refused and the refusal is recorded (C8)
rules.unreachable: if the agent cannot be reached or times out, the code's own answer stands, marked unresolved; nothing is guessed (C9)
rules.recorded: every answer carries source (code|model|agent), confidence and one line of reason; the tier that answered is in the row (C7)
